name: ワークスペース共通ひな型の説明付き空状態
prompt:
Recreate the supplied Linear workspace issue-template empty-state section as a faithful Japanese localization. Match the exact unusually wide 814 by 224 pixel crop, aspect ratio 3.63:1. Use the whole wide canvas and keep all content in the same horizontal positions; do not place the design inside a square card, do not add vertical blank bands, and do not crop any text or the right-side action.

At the upper-left, place a bold dark heading 「課題テンプレート」 at the same x and y as the source. Under it, preserve two compact left-aligned lines of small muted-gray explanatory text, with the same line spacing and approximately the same horizontal extent:
「これらのテンプレートは、ワークスペース内のどのチームでも課題の作成時に利用できます。」
「特定のチーム専用のテンプレートは、チームテンプレートとして追加してください。」
End the second line with a blue clickable text link 「ドキュメント ↗」. Keep the arrow small and pointing diagonally upward-right.

Below the text, at the same vertical position as the source, draw one nearly full-width low rounded rectangular empty-state row with a thin pale-gray border, white fill, and a gentle 12-pixel corner radius. Its left label is 「課題テンプレートはありません」 in dark gray, aligned about 20 pixels inside the left edge and vertically centered. At the far right, align a small dark plus icon followed by 「新しいテンプレート」, vertically centered, with the same spacing and right padding as the source.

Use crisp compact Linear-style interface typography, a white background, a bold heading, muted body text, restrained blue link, subtle border, and no extra controls or artwork. Preserve the wide 3.63:1 shape, exact hierarchy, two body lines, and single empty-state row. Do not add a sidebar, toolbar, labels, names, or content outside the supplied component.
reviewNotes: The Japanese heading, two-line guidance, Docs link, empty-state row, plus, and create action are present and visually coherent. Needs-correction: ImageGen returned 2170x725 (2.993:1) for the 814x224 (3.634:1) crop, leaving the composition 17.6% too narrow. Similar wide-strip ratio failures have recurred; stopped after one attempt under the established limitation.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
